name: mismatch-senior-devops
notes: Fundamental mismatch: a senior infrastructure role against a student résumé with no infra experience. Per the scoring rubric this should land low (<35 is 'wrong domain/level/stack'). The point of the case is that almost everything belongs in missing and the model must not manufacture credit — nor propose fabricated duration claims like '8+ years'.
jd:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer

8+ years operating production infrastructure at scale. You will own our Kubernetes fleet and on-call rotation.

Requirements:
- Kubernetes at production scale
- Terraform / infrastructure as code
- Go
- Prometheus and Grafana observability
- Incident command and on-call leadership
- Linux systems administration
